answer: In this PoA design, identity verification is bound to a Wesolowski VDF: each claimant must perform a prescribed chain of sequential modular squarings and provide a succinct proof of correct execution. Dependencies between rounds prevent splitting one identity’s computation across GPUs, so simulated clones multiply elapsed work rather than eliminate it. Thus every identity labeled raven, voyage, or basalt consumes real sequential time, imposing a strict physical bottleneck on Sybil creation.
